paragraphs.text: Incarnation is a creature type that represents a (sentient) creature which is the material manifestation of a force or concept whose original nature is immaterial.

Incarnation is a creature type that first appeared in Judgment . The first Incarnations were Genesis ( ) and Glory ( ) and the Judgement cycle (see below). During Judgement's design, Incarnations were called "Jedi", referencing the quote spoken by the character Obi-Wan Kenobi in the film Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope , "If you strike me down, I shall become more powerful than you can possibly imagine."
Personal Incarnation from Alpha gained the subtype retroactively.

Incarnations were frequently printed in multicolored cycles. The only Incarnations not belonging to a cycle are Personal Incarnation , Genesis , Glory , Idris, Soul of the TARDIS , Indris, the Hydrostatic Surge , and Infestation
Elemental Incarnations can be found on Dominaria and Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .
Otterfolk weavers working in concert appear able to summon Indris , an incarnation of lightning that takes the form of a large otter.
Doctor Who introduced the first multicolored Incarnation for Idris , the physical embodiment of the TARDIS matrix in a human body.
